race.comment: Good little race. FARAWAY DREAM (6) has been solid in two runs back and should be ready to fire now in what looks a nice race for her following a few key scratchings. PICK 'N' MIX (4) has jumped out well and looks to get all the favours from the good draw. Rates well and looms as a major threat. ROSANGELA (10) won well last start and has to be a strong chance if able to repeat. OBUCCI (9) also won well last start and appears the next in line.
